capture_method: User-supplied physical-device screenshot plus source-contract inspection; this repository intentionally has no DebugBridge or GET /state/snapshot integration.
privacy: The screenshot pixels were not copied into the repository because they contain private camera content. Only non-content geometry is recorded.
source_evidence: UIImagePickerController hides its native controls but no cameraViewTransform is applied, so its 4:3 preview does not fill a tall full-screen cover.
expected: Every Take Photo presentation, including reopening after dismissal, aspect-fills the entire capture surface behind the SwiftUI controls.
